mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 57 degrees and partly cloudy at Reddan Soccer Park. We are under a Waning Gibbous moon and can look forward to an ISS flyover at 5:05 AM rising over the area of Verona High School and traveling towards the area near Home Depot. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 49 with no rain predicted.

The city has updated its engineering reports, which track contracts with AECOM Inc. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding meetings regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study on November 18 and 19 for those interested in design concepts and providing feedback.

There is a busy schedule of local events tomorrow including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, a pizza and pitcher night at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
On October 25, Verona police officers arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was discovered passed out in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.

Today's flavor of the day was Chocolate Caramel Twist. As we are currently closed for the night, please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM when we will be serving our flavor of the day, Chocolate Heath Crunch.
